overview.title: Why riders choose Dakhla
overview.p1: Consistent side-onshore winds and waist-deep flat water make the lagoon ideal for learning and for long freestyle or freeride sessions. Schools and camps cluster at well-known kilometre markers along the shore.
overview.p2: PK zones and speed stretches offer glass when conditions align. Ocean-side spots add waves for advanced riders who want Atlantic energy.
overview.p3: Book lessons or rental through a recognised school. Respect rescue zones, local rules and other water users.

q1.question: Is Dakhla good for beginners?
q1.answer: Yes — shallow flat water and professional schools make it one of the best places to learn.

q2.question: When is the wind best?
q2.answer: Often strongest from spring through early autumn; check daily forecasts.

q3.question: Do I need my own gear?
q3.answer: No — schools rent equipment; bring personal items you prefer.

q4.question: Wingfoil too?
q4.answer: Yes — the same lagoon suits wingfoil when wind and space allow.

q5.question: Ocean vs lagoon?
q5.answer: Lagoon is flat and protected; ocean spots like Foum El Bouir are for waves and advanced riders.
